content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To have a family dinner, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Polish the formal silverware (30 minutes)
Step 2. Research a recipe for beef bourguignon (20 minutes)
Step 3. Wash and peel the organic carrots (10 minutes)
Step 4. Sear the beef in a heavy pot (15 minutes)
Step 5. Set the table with a clean tablecloth (5 minutes)
Step 6. Whip the heavy cream for dessert (10 minutes)
Step 7. Sauté the onions and garlic (8 minutes)
Step 8. Chill the whipped cream in the fridge (1 hour)
Step 9. Iron the linen napkins (15 minutes)
Step 10. Clear the mail off the dining table (2 minutes)
Step 11. Add the red wine reduction to the pot (5 minutes)
Step 12. Chop the mushrooms and pearl onions (15 minutes)
Step 13. Simmer the stew on low heat (3 hours)
Step 14. Prepare a side salad of mixed greens (10 minutes)
Step 15. Choose a playlist for background music (10 minutes)
Step 16. Decant the red wine (45 minutes)
Step 17. Sauté the mushrooms in butter (12 minutes)
Step 18. Open the wine bottles (2 minutes)
Step 19. Thyme and bay leaf bouquet garni preparation (3 minutes)
Step 20. Go to the grocery store for ingredients (1 hour)
Step 21. Sharpen the kitchen knives (5 minutes)
Step 22. Pick up a fresh baguette from the bakery (20 minutes)
Step 23. Whisk together a vinaigrette (5 minutes)
Step 24. Measure out the beef stock (2 minutes)
Step 25. Scrub the potatoes for mashing (10 minutes)
Step 26. Wash all the raw vegetables (15 minutes)
Step 27. Arrange the centerpiece flowers (20 minutes)
Step 28. Take the heavy cream out of the fridge (1 minute)
Step 29. Fold the ironed napkins (10 minutes)
Step 30. Light the scented candles (1 minute)
Step 31. Place the plates and cutlery on the table (10 minutes)
Step 32. Warm the serving platters (15 minutes)
Step 33. Slice the fresh baguette (5 minutes)
Step 34. Prepare the dessert berries (12 minutes)
Step 35. Pour water into the glasses (3 minutes)
Step 36. Transfer the food to serving bowls (10 minutes)
Step 37. Check the oven temperature (1 minute)
Step 38. Grate some fresh parmesan (4 minutes)
Step 39. Call the family to the table (2 minutes)
Step 40. Preheat the oven for the bread (10 minutes)
